title: Preserve valid Codex completion when optional artifacts are malformed
description:
## Real reproduction

The smart Codex turn for kbs-5f70d4 returned a valid completed result, summary, review update, and issue comment. Its optional artifacts used path and description plus verification fields rather than the strict name/ref schema. Rust rejected the whole result with Codex router adapter returned invalid result after the agent had completed.

## Required behavior

Raw agent output must be persisted first. Validation errors after a saved session must be sent back to the same session with the exact reason, or the router must safely normalize non-authoritative artifact metadata while retaining the valid outcome. A malformed optional artifact must never discard a valid completed turn.

## Acceptance criteria

- Python and Rust have matching result-validation behavior.
- The exact kbs-5f70d4 output shape either triggers a same-session corrective turn or lands in Review with preserved summary, comment, branch, PR, session, and raw log.
- No malformed optional artifact can cause an invisible Open issue or auto-close.
- Tests cover JSONL AgentMessage final-answer envelopes and strict/normalized artifact behavior.
- After repair, run a real single-worker dispatch through the complete Review handoff.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live router result preserved: Codex completed the malformed-optional-artifact recovery patch in draft PR #312. Summary: normalized optional artifact metadata consistently in Python and Rust while retaining strict validation for authoritative fields; added JSONL AgentMessage and malformed-artifact coverage. Focused Python router-adapter tests, focused Rust unit test, and the cross-runtime integration harness passed. Moving to Review for code review; the router-to-canonical-board state sync gap is being tracked separately.
